alert_summary.trigger: Blood glucose reading of 210 mg/dL detected by Dexcom G6 CGM, exceeding threshold of 180 mg/dL

clinical_brief.contextual_analysis: The glucose elevation to 210 mg/dL occurred three days after the patient began a planned high-carbohydrate diet trial with a nutritionist (Anamnesis). EHR notes from 2026-02-01 confirm this dietary change was discussed and planned, and the patient remains adherent to Metformin and Empagliflozin with no missed doses reported (EHR, Anamnesis). No hyperglycemia symptoms are reported (Anamnesis).
clinical_brief.risk_assessment: This glucose elevation may suggest a transient response to the recent high-carbohydrate diet trial rather than medication nonadherence or acute decompensation. Continued monitoring could indicate whether this is an expected effect of the dietary intervention.

recommended_actions.action: Consider monitoring glucose trends over the next several days to assess response to dietary trial
Suggest patient contacts care team if symptoms of hyperglycemia develop or if glucose remains >200 mg/dL for multiple readings
Review dietary plan with nutritionist and consider adjusting carbohydrate intake if persistent elevations occur

No recent vital signs or weight data
No explicit documentation of food intake quantities/types
No reported symptoms, but specific hyperglycemia symptoms (thirst, polyuria) not explicitly queried
No documentation of recent weight changes
